```{r setup}
#! include: false

library(treemapify)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

output_dir <- here("results", "species_estimation_qmd", "20260615")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Colour Brewer paired palette
colour_brewer <- setNames(append(as.list(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired")), c("#737373", "#FFFFFF", "#000000")), c("blue", "darkblue", "green", "darkgreen", "red", "darkred", "orange", "darkorange", "purple", "darkpurple", "yellow", "brown", "grey", "white", "black"))

# Paul Tol's vibrant palette - colourblind friendly
vibrant_colours <- c("#CC3311", "#0077BB", "#009988", "#EE3377", "#EE7733", "#33BBEE")
# Paul Tol's muted palette - plus 3 extras
muted_colours <- c("#882255", "#332288", "#DDCC77", "#117733", "#88CCEE", "#CC6677", "#44AA99", "#999933", "#AA4499", "#BBBBBB", "#EE7733", "#CC3311")
# Paul Tol's bright palette - colourblind friendly
bright_colours <- c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833", "#CCBB44", "#66CCEE", "#AA3377", "#BBBBBB")

cluster_type_levels <- c("genome_linked", "multi_sample", "multi_hit", "single_singleton")
```

```{r wrangling}
if (file.exists(here(output_dir, "wrangling.RData"))) {
  load(here(output_dir, "wrangling.RData"))
  print("Using prior wrangling")
} else {

  input_dir <- here("results", "species_estimation", "20260615")

  summary <- read_tsv(here(input_dir, "summary.tsv"))

  cluster_summary <- tibble(
      marker = list.dirs(here(input_dir), full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)
    ) %>%
    filter(str_detect(marker, "^S3.")) %>%
    mutate(
      tsv_path = here(input_dir, marker, str_c(marker, ".tsv")),
      data = map(tsv_path, ~
        read_tsv(.) %>%
        mutate(
          # rep_status = factor(unknown, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("GlobDB", "unknown")),
          # rep_hits = hits,
          cluster_n = cluster_size,
          cluster_status = n_query > 0,
          cluster_status = factor(cluster_status, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("GlobDB", "unknown")),
          # cluster_max_hits = max_hits,
          cluster_total_hits = total_hits,
          cluster_type = case_when(
            cluster_status == "GlobDB" ~ "genome_linked",
            cluster_n > 1 ~ "multi_sample",
            cluster_total_hits > 1 ~ "multi_hit",
            TRUE ~ "single_singleton"
          ),
        ) %>%
        group_by(cluster_type) %>%
        summarise(
          n = n(),
          size_min = min(cluster_n),
          size_max = max(cluster_n),
          size_median = median(cluster_n),
          total_hits_min = min(cluster_total_hits),
          total_hits_max = max(cluster_total_hits),
          total_hits_median = median(cluster_total_hits),
          .groups = "drop"
          )
      ),
    ) %>%
    select(-c(tsv_path)) %>%
    unnest(data)

  save.image(here(output_dir, "wrangling.RData"))
}
```

```{r stats}
# Min/max/median OTU and cluster counts
summary %>%
  summarise(
    min_otus = min(num_otus),
    max_otus = max(num_otus),
    median_otus = median(num_otus),
    min_clusters = min(num_clusters),
    max_clusters = max(num_clusters),
    median_clusters = median(num_clusters)
  )

# Cluster types
cluster_summary %>%
  select(marker, cluster_type, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = cluster_type,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

```{r analysis}
# Stacked barplot of cluster types per marker
cluster_summary %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  select(marker, cluster_type, n, prop) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(n, prop), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    marker = factor(marker),
    marker_n = str_extract(marker, "(?<=S3.)\\d+") %>% as.integer(),
    cluster_type = factor(cluster_type, levels = cluster_type_levels)
    ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(marker, marker_n), y = value, fill = cluster_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = muted_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  xlab("Marker") +
  ylab("Count / Proportion") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(here(output_dir, "cluster_type_barplot.png"), width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 600)

# Treemap of cluster types as a median proportion across markers
cluster_summary %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    cluster_type = factor(cluster_type, levels = cluster_type_levels)
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cluster_type) %>%
  summarise(median_prop = median(prop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(area = median_prop, fill = cluster_type, label = cluster_type)) +
  treemapify::geom_treemap() +
  treemapify::geom_treemap_text(
    colour = "white", place = "centre",
    grow = FALSE, reflow = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = muted_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(here(output_dir, "cluster_type_treemap.png"), width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 600)
```
